upstream_title: Study Data Tabulation Model Implementation Guide: Human Clinical Trials
capture_method: official CDISC HTML inspection; normalized metadata and paraphrased evidence only

locators.claim: The guide organizes observations, variables, datasets, domains and general observation classes for tabulation data.
Submission metadata and conformance are part of the implementation context.
Domain and variable mapping must be interpreted with the guide's general and domain-specific assumptions.
Adverse events are represented in the AE events domain using the applicable domain specification and controlled terminology.

rights_note: This repository stores only project-authored metadata and paraphrases; consult the official CDISC HTML for authoritative wording and current controlled terminology.
